title: Migration 005 can overwrite an already-migrated whisper_model value

evidence.quote: # Check which columns already exist (some may have been added by manual scripts)

reasoning: The migration explicitly supports partially migrated databases where new columns may already exist, but it still copies summarize_sh_whisper_model into whisper_model whenever the legacy column exists. If a manual/partial migration already created whisper_model and the application or user changed it, running Alembic 005 later will replace that value with the legacy column value. The copy should be conditional on whisper_model being newly created, blank, or still at the default, not merely on the old column existing.
reproduction: Create client_config with summarize_sh_whisper_model='base.en' and an already-existing whisper_model='large-v3', then run revision 005. The UPDATE resets whisper_model to 'base.en'.
recommendation: Track whether whisper_model was added by this upgrade, or guard the UPDATE with a predicate that only fills empty/default values. Do not overwrite an existing non-empty whisper_model on partially migrated databases.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked migration tests were supplied, and this requires a partially migrated schema with both legacy and replacement columns present.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a migration test that seeds client_config with both summarize_sh_whisper_model and whisper_model, runs revision 005, and asserts the existing whisper_model value is preserved.
